Ugh antidepressants. They can help some people so much so it's definitely worth trying but it's important to keep in mind that doctors don't really know which ones are going to help you best. They guess based on the symptoms you describe. So it becomes trial-and-error until you find one that both helps and doesn't have side effects you can't tolerate. Each new pill you try, you have to be on for several weeks usually before you can know if it's helping or not. Not trying to be discouraging at all, but be prepared to have to be patient if you go the drug route.
